description: Source code for parsing command-line options (parse-options.c). It provides functions and data structures for handling command-line argument parsing, including long and short options, subcommands, help messages, and error handling in a command-line application, similar to Git's style.

methods.name: void optbug(const struct option * opt,const char * reason)
methods.description: Logs bugs related to invalid option configurations, reporting problematic switches or options.

methods.name: const char * optname(const struct option * opt,enum opt_parsed flags)
methods.description: Returns a string describing the option name(s) based on provided flags.

methods.name: enum:parse_opt_result get_arg(struct parse_opt_ctx_t * p,const struct option * opt,enum opt_parsed flags,const char ** arg)
methods.description: Retrieves the argument for an option if available, handling different parsing contexts.

methods.name: char * fix_filename(const char * prefix,const char * file)
methods.description: Adjusts filename strings, handling optional parameters.

methods.name: int do_get_int_value(const void * value,size_t precision,intmax_t * ret)
methods.description: Reads integer values from a generic pointer based on specified size.

methods.name: intmax_t get_int_value(const struct option * opt,enum opt_parsed flags)
methods.description: Gets the integer value of an option, considering its type and size.

methods.name: enum:parse_opt_result set_int_value(const struct option * opt,enum opt_parsed flags,intmax_t value)
methods.description: Sets an integer value for an option, respecting its size and type.

methods.name: int signed_int_fits(intmax_t value,size_t precision)
methods.description: Checks if an integer value fits within the specified precision bounds.

methods.name: enum:parse_opt_result do_get_value(struct parse_opt_ctx_t * p,const struct option * opt,enum opt_parsed flags,const char ** argp)
methods.description: Performs the core logic to parse and retrieve value(s) for a given option, handling various option types and flags.

methods.name: void build_cmdmode_list(struct parse_opt_ctx_t * ctx,const struct option * opts)
methods.description: Builds a linked list of command mode options based on the current parsing context.

methods.name: char * optnamearg(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,enum opt_parsed flags)
methods.description: Creates a descriptive string for an option and its argument based on flags.

methods.name: enum:parse_opt_result get_value(struct parse_opt_ctx_t * p,const struct option * opt,enum opt_parsed flags)
methods.description: Retrieves and processes the value for an option, managing conflicts and command modes.

methods.name: enum:parse_opt_result parse_short_opt(struct parse_opt_ctx_t * p,const struct option * options)
methods.description: Parses a short option from the command line arguments.

methods.name: int has_string(const char * it,const char ** array)
methods.description: Checks if a string is present in an array of strings.

methods.name: int is_alias(struct parse_opt_ctx_t * ctx,const struct option * one_opt,const struct option * another_opt)
methods.description: Determines whether two options are aliases based on shared groups.

methods.name: void register_abbrev(struct parse_opt_ctx_t * p,const struct option * option,enum opt_parsed flags,struct parsed_option * abbrev,struct parsed_option * ambiguous)
methods.description: Registers abbreviated options, handling ambiguity.

methods.name: enum:parse_opt_result parse_long_opt(struct parse_opt_ctx_t * p,const char * arg,const struct option * options)
methods.description: Parses a long command-line option, handling negations, abbreviations, and assignments.

methods.description: Parses options without a leading dash.

methods.description: Handles subcommand recognition and setup.
